card.name: Partway through dosing schedule lines
card.fires_on: Words and word parts in the middle of dosing lines or interaction tables, just before the next dose or schedule term. Examples are b before .i.d., 'divided' before Q12 hrs, and the end of a drug name before an arrow.

modes.label: Inside dose schedules
modes.description: A word or part of one inside a dose-frequency phrase, right before the schedule term.

modes.label: Drug names in interaction tables
modes.description: The middle or end of a drug name in an interaction row, before an arrow or effect.

modes.label: Section number cross-references
modes.description: A digit inside a bracketed section reference such as Warnings and Precautions.
modes.example: Warnings and Precautions (<<5>>.5) ] Have diabetes mellitus

card.writes: It promotes short capital-letter abbreviations such as PO, HT and WB and suppresses code-like tokens, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires partway through dosing lines and drug-interaction tables, just before the next piece of the entry.
